intent: Premium dark three-plan pricing with a softly glowing featured plan, odometer prices and a sliding billing toggle.

layout.header: eyebrow, two-tone title, then body (left) + billing toggle (right) on desktop
layout.plans: 3 columns at lg (featured -16px vertical margin); stacked on mobile; at md each card is 2 columns (price | features)

motion.tokens: ease-out [0.22,1,0.36,1]; ease-in [0.4,0,1,1] for exits; spring.ui stiffness 500 damping 40
motion.toggle: layoutId spring.ui; options scale 0.97 on press; the saving pill pulses once to 1.06 when annual turns on and turns neutral on monthly
motion.price: per-digit odometer, critically damped spring stiffness 160 damping 25, 70ms stagger; on annual the monthly price appears struck through above the unit (4px rise, 2px blur, 240ms)
motion.billingNote: in from 8px with 3px blur over 300ms, out upward in 200ms ease-in
motion.cta: arrow nudges 3px on hover (200ms); press scales to 0.98; the white CTA deepens its glow instead of greying
motion.pointer: per-card spotlight (420px radial) and edge arc (240px, masked to the 1px border) tracked through CSS variables; mouse only
motion.reveal: cards rise 18px over 600ms staggered 70ms; feature rows 45ms apart; once
motion.footnotes: markers link to their note; hover or focus lights both in 150ms
motion.reducedMotion: instant swaps, opacity-only reveals, no pointer light

responsive.mobile: stacked cards, toggle under body, full-width CTAs
